description: This file implements the core logic of the WebBridge plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes plugin registration, initialization, message handling (RPC and WebSocket), registration management, and timeout cleanup for asynchronous requests.

classes.name: Registration
classes.description: A JSON container class used to handle registration requests, storing event and callsign information.

methods.name: WebBridge::Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the plugin with the provided service, reading configuration and preparing internal state.

methods.name: WebBridge::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, releasing resources and resetting state.

methods.name: WebBridge::Attach
methods.description: Handles a new channel connection, specifically for JSON protocol, and associates the channel with the plugin.

methods.name: WebBridge::Invoke
methods.description: Processes incoming RPC messages, handles registration, unregistration, and forwards custom requests.

methods.name: WebBridge::Inbound (by ID)
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages, including event dispatch and responses to pending requests.

methods.name: WebBridge::Cleanup
methods.description: Checks pending requests for timeout and reports errors if no response is received within the timeout period.

methods.name: WebBridge::InternalMessage
methods.description: Detects and processes internal control messages like method registrations.
